title: COP Gets Pulled Over & Police Make A SHOCKING Discovery
description:
COP gets pulled over & police make a SHOCKING discovery...

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/eNj3ek5ME-U

transcript.text: Get out of the car! Get out of the fucking car! I don't give a fuck who you are. Get on your goddamn knees. On Sunday, June 12, 2022, a police officer was parked on the side of the road when he noticed in his rearview mirror that a white Chrysler 300 was rapidly approaching. This was all about to take a dramatic turn. The driver quickly passes the visible and marked police vehicle. Immediately, the officer pursues the car. It didn't take long before the high-speed chase is spotted by another officer. the Chrysler isn't slowing down and even begins to accelerate after several miles the suspect slows down and comes to a complete halt get out of the car walk right here shut the fuck up yeah i'm a cop why you why you're asking me when i tell you to get on your feet knees
